verdict.rationale: Netlify documents per-PR Deploy Previews, and a community user confirms that its GitHub integration builds a preview for every PR. However, the evidence never says these previews are full-stack, meaning they include serverless functions or isolated database branches per PR. It also never says they are ephemeral or torn down when the PR closes. Missing for 10: evidence that previews include backend functions and data per PR, documented ephemeral lifecycle and cleanup on merge or close.

support.subject: As a developer, I can get ephemeral full-stack preview environments for every pull request
